assistant.headerSub: Configure the English-first voice and text AI assistant, keyboard shortcuts, and backend permission levels.
assistant.enableDesc: Display the floating assistant orb and allow in-app voice and text commands.
assistant.permissionsDesc: Enforced on the backend to prevent unauthorized mutations.
assistant.level2: Level 2: Suggest (Prepares drafts and proposals without execution)

assistant.voiceDesc: Configure spoken audio responses and available browser voices.
assistant.shortcutDesc: Global within-app keyboard shortcut to toggle the assistant.
assistant.privacyDesc: Allow the assistant to access active investigation metadata to provide contextual compliance assistance.
